_about: Round 4 IMPACT: hits with weight in the % ring (BendImpact, RingMoment, CameraShake.jolt, RingWater.ko_splash). The owner chose hit-stop, the camera kick (an offset jolt that never turns the camera or moves the aim) and the ring-out moment (the splash). Only how a hit FEELS: no launch, hitstun, lock or guard number lives here. enabled false turns every part off (no hold, no jolt, no moment; the KO splash stays the old one).

hitstop._about: The hold on a launch: hold_s = lerp(hold_min_s, hold_max_s, clamp((|v| - lo_mps) / span_mps, 0, 1)), at most hold_share of the hit's hitstun, none under stop_min_mps. The struck one's pose and launch wait it out inside his hitstun (it still counts from the hit); the hitter's pose holds too within melee_m. After a hold a pose plays at catchup_k until it has made up the time it stood (so it is back in step with the body: a cast's strike point, a fighter's hit parts). knock_thud at the hold's start: thud_db_lo..hi and thud_pitch_lo..hi from soft to hard.
hitstop._2026_10_13: Testers: "the hits feel like they have no impact". The hold longer (0.06-0.16 s, was 0.04-0.11 s; at most half the hitstun, was 0.4 of it) and the thud louder (-4..5 dB, was -6..2 dB).

impact._about: The impact drawn on whom a launch strikes (BendLooks.hit_impact, called by BendImpact.on_hit with the hold; testers 2026-10-13: "the hits feel like they have no impact"). Visual only. flash: his body lit white over his own look for the hold and flash_tail_s more, its strength flash_min (soft) to 1 (hard). spark: at his chest a hot flash, a ring across the blow and streaks thrown on along it, spark_k its size. A launch of trail_min_mps or more leaves puffs behind him for trail_s once he flies. Nothing here touches anyone's aim, camera turn, movement or lock.

jolt._about: The local player's view knocked aside (CameraShake.jolt: h_offset / v_offset, m; never a turn). Taking a launch of take_min_mps or more: take_amount over take_secs, from take_min_mps to take_full_mps. Landing one of deal_min_mps or more: deal_k of that. A fall into the water within ko_near_m: ko_amount over ko_secs. His perfect guard: perfect_amount over perfect_secs. on false: none (the Esc row is GameSettings [ring] jolt).
jolt._2026_10_13: Testers: "the hits feel like they have no impact". A launch taken kicks the view harder (0.16-0.45 m, was 0.12-0.35 m), and the hitter feels his own from 7 m/s at 0.7 of it (was from 9 m/s at 0.5). Still offsets only: never a turn, the aim never moves.

perfect._about: A perfect guard's beat: the guarder's pose holds hold_s, and the sender's when he is within sender_m. Poses only: the catch, its return and the stone's flight never wait.

moment._about: The ring-out moment (RingMoment). Every fall: the KO splash, its sound, the jolt; play goes on. A game's last fall (its last life, or sudden death): Engine.time_scale eases to slow_scale over ease_in_s, holds hold_real_s of real time, comes back over ease_out_s (always put back: the end, the scene's exit, a restart, an Esc pause, a second fall), the splash at final_splash_k. Practice: practice_moment / practice_jolt (the hit-stop stays: the feel of a hit is the lesson).

ko_splash._about: RingWater.ko_splash: a column column_m tall (from the entry speed speed_mps lo..hi), drops falling at gravity, sheets of spray thrown out round it (sheet_mps, sheet_up its rise to its spread), ripple rings running out ripple_m over ripple_s, foam foam_m across lying foam_s. ringout_splash at sound_db, knock_thud at low_pitch (low_db) under it.
